# streamtime_api_key (Resource)

An API key for scripts and automation. Streamtime shows the key value only when it creates the key, so it is kept in the Terraform state, marked sensitive.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "streamtime_api_key" "ci" {
  name = "ci-pipeline"
  role = "Agent"
}

# Streamtime shows the key value only when it creates the key.
output "ci_api_key" {
  value     = streamtime_api_key.ci.key
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A name that tells you what the key is for. Up to 50 characters.
- `role` (String) The role the key acts with, for example Agent or Administrator. A name and role pair can be used only once.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the API key. Use it to import an existing key.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) The key value. Streamtime returns it only when the key is created, so it is empty for a key you imported. Create a new key if you need the value of an imported one.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the API key's ID. The key value is not returned for an imported key.
terraform import streamtime_api_key.ci 6f1c2d3e-0000-4000-8000-000000000000
```
